title: Signatures
titleTooltip: Sign lab notes for timestamped certification. Signed notes cannot be modified and hold legal evidential value.
subtitle: Lab note electronic signature and certification management
signedTooltip: Number of notes that have been signed and certified.
pendingTooltip: Notes awaiting signature. Change note status to 'In Progress' before signing.
lockedTooltip: Notes fully locked after signing. No modifications allowed.
tableTooltip: View signature status of all lab notes. Pending notes can be signed after clicking 'Start Progress' in the editor.
